_note_target_year: Simulation runs years 2024 through 2123 inclusive (100 simulated years per replicate, with --replicates 100 per the run.sh contract). 'Year 100' is calendar year 2123 — the last year of the run. The scorer filters the CSV to year == target_year and computes the mean across cells AND across replicates.
_note_bands_provisional: These bands are placeholders pending Open Q #1 in K8S_REFACTOR.md (year-100 acceptance-band recalibration). They are deliberately loose so a faithful run cannot be a false negative; they will be tightened against a reference distribution once the headline batch produces one. Do not interpret a pass on these bands as proof of spec faithfulness — interpret a fail as proof of un-faithfulness.

height_year100._metric: Mean (across all cells and all replicates) of meanHeight column at year == target_year.

occupancy_year100._metric: Mean tree count per cell at year == target_year, averaged across replicates.
